message:
For **Pell**, the supplied codebook gives these source passages:

**Total discounts and allowances from Pell grants** (2024-25 · Provisional · F2324_F1A · F1E12)

> Pell grants represents the gross amount of Pell grants disbursed or otherwise made available to recipients by the institution.

**Total discounts and allowances from Pell grants** (2024-25 · Provisional · F2324_F2 · F2C12)

> Pell grants includes the amount administered by the institution under the Pell grant program .Private institutions generally report Pell Grants as agency transactions.

**Total discounts and allowances from Pell grants** (2024-25 · Provisional · F2324_F3 · F3C12)

> Pell grants includes amounts administered by the institution under the Pell grant program.

These excerpts retain their source-specific scope. Full definitions and source locations are under Definitions & sources.

evidence.title: Total discounts and allowances from Pell grants
evidence.definition: Pell grants represents the gross amount of Pell grants disbursed or otherwise made available to recipients by the institution. Total discounts and allowances is the sum of discounts and allowances that were recorded as an offset (reduction) to the revenues of tuition and fees and auxiliary enterprises

evidence.definition: Pell grants includes the amount administered by the institution under the Pell grant program .Private institutions generally report Pell Grants as agency transactions. Total discounts and allowances is the sum of discounts and allowances applied to both tuition & fees and auxiliary enterprises.
